audit.why: EVEN / 5.5/10 sits right for 46.71% over 167 games: Ziggs owns levels 1-2 and 4-5 on range (850 Bouncing Bomb, a flat 16s minefield), Neeko owns level 3, level 6 and first item, and it flattens out late.

audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[0..6].side were all 'Skill' while content win reads Ziggs/Ziggs/Neeko/Ziggs/Neeko/Neeko/Skill.
audit.why: Same row, two layers, two answers. packet.levelChart matches the content layer, so the full layer is stale.
audit.corrected: All seven sides set to the content values with every why rewritten in the same group, keyed to the real spikes: his 850 range early, the flat 16s minefield at 4-5, your level 3 and level 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three content fields tell the reader to 'dash' with W Shapesplitter — whys[2], wants.you[0], spikes[0] and mid all describe a 'dash-root' window.
audit.why: Shapesplitter has no dash. Riot's text gives a clone sent in a direction plus a move-speed passive on every third attack. A player told to dash will walk into an 850-range poke lane expecting mobility that does not exist.
audit.corrected: Rewritten as W move speed used to close.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit, and dosFull[2].d invented a 'fifteen-second invitation' for Satchel Charge.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1 and 12s at rank 5 — never fifteen. Bouncing Bomb is 6s to 4s at 850, Hexplosive Minefield a flat 16s at 900, Mega Inferno Bomb 120/95/70s.
audit.corrected: All four cooldowns written in; the invented fifteen replaced with the real 12-to-20 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: Short Fuse never appears as a trade tell.
audit.why: Short Fuse is an auto-attack reset whose cooldown drops every time he casts an ability, so his poke pattern is bomb-plus-empowered-auto, not bomb alone — the wind-up is the cue to step back.
audit.corrected: Written into tradeBad, breakdown.early and the minefield don't.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to their own titles; dontsFull[2] retitled to the mistake that actually loses this lane — walking onto a live mine.

notes: The brief's missingInteractions claims Ziggs 'bypasses stacking resistances' via Satchel Charge and the kit carries a percentHealth flag on that ability. Riot's own text describes flat magic damage plus a knockback and the turret hexplode — there is no percent-health component — so per the brief's rule I trusted the description and wrote nothing about resistances being invalidated. Flagged in unverified. The autoreset tell on Short Fuse does match Riot's text and is now on the page. Also fixed a real kit error the page repeated in four places: Shapesplitter was described as a dash. It is a clone plus a move-speed passive. packet.games reads 167 and MC_REAL_GAMES agrees, so this matchup was audited normally. Ratings left untouched (scale not self-consistent); breakdown.wave, breakdown.feeding and 'ahead' remain templated.
